Marta: idea 3844f7 neighborhood lights walk this weekend? snap a pic of your block and drop it here. small raffle for a $25 gift card to a local cafe.
Eli: love that. is this in-person or remote-friendly?
Marta: both! in-person folks can meet at 6pm outside HQ, remote people post photos of local displays. we'll run a people's choice raffle.
Priya: RSVP'd 44d will share a twilight skyline pic if i can make it.
Osman: quick note: keep streetsafe and mask up if crowded. also bring a flashlight.
cheer-bot: Reminder: "Neighborhood Lights Walk" meetup 2026-12-19 18:00 PT. React with :white_check_mark: to RSVP.
Eli: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/lights-eli.jpg caption: "cul-de-sac synchronized to Mariah" #remote-friendly
Priya: posted photo: https://files.redwood.example/lights-priya.jpg caption: "front porch cascade"

Marta: small contest rules: one photo per person, include a 1-line holiday wish or shoutout to a coworker when you post.
Priya: shoutout: "thanks @Eli for the late-night deploy help 60a"
Eli: shoutout: "@Priya for the clean rollout notes"
Osman: shoutout: "@Marta for organizing seasonal chaos"
cheer-bot: Poll created: People's Choice raffle entry: react to your favorite photo by 2026-12-20 09:00 PT. Winners randomly drawn among reactions.
Marta: also tiny eco-request: try battery-free lights if possible, or take down displays before midnight so owls don't get confused.
Eli: reacted :sparkles: to Marta
Priya: reacted :heart: to Eli
Osman: reacted :star: to Priya
Marta: raffle note: if winner is remote, gift card will be digital. winners announced Monday morning in this thread. thanks everyone for sharing 384
Eli: caption add: "synchronized to my questionable ukulele playing"
Priya: caption add: "curated by leftover wrapping paper"
cheer-bot: Reminder: Submission window closes 2026-12-20 09:00 PT. Good luck!
Marta: last call for pics and wishes. stay safe and enjoy the lights :sparkler:
